title: VYBE 0.11.2
notes: Release 0.11.2: Multi-source dynamic recommendation engine (OuterTune automix seeds + EchoMusic anti-history deduplication + Meld Spotify hybridization), playlist queue disappearing & single-song infinite loop bug fix, artist profile cleanup (original songs/videos only, zero jukeboxes/junk), account backup card with size badge & manual trigger, artist Follow & Block buttons, and fullscreen landscape video lock.
